Seven local regression turn roots are absent from the returned backend telemetry. Their eligibility/feedback cannot be verified from a stored root; do not count them as healthy negatives.
A complete query means the server returned its reported total, not that every locally emitted span arrived.
The old evaluation completed with operational/judge errors; it is not a valid 13-case quality score.
Signal tag generation may fail or lag; missing eligible feedback is pending, not a successful tag.
Backend costs cover returned usage estimates, not invoices or Signal-worker inference charges.
